# Turboslide

> A block document with a validator and a grammar linter; every operation is a named action in one table, reachable from the CLI, MCP, HTTP and the studio window API (SPEC 1, 7.1).

Turboslide holds the GT brand deck as typed JSON (deck.json plus slides/<id>.json), renders it with one renderer, lints it against the deck grammar, and exports it to PPTX with a verified report, pixel identical in its default mode (docs/pptx.md). There are no coordinates: a slide is a kind, a layout and typed blocks in named slots.

## Discovery

- /api/agent: the manifest (transports, rules, execution rules, action ids, skills, resources, what this instance implements)
- /openapi.json: the OpenAPI 3.1 contract of POST /api/actions/<id>
- /mcp: MCP over streamable HTTP; `turboslide mcp` is the same server over stdio
- /llms-full.txt: this guide with every action and every lint rule
- skills/turboslide-{create,api,studio,verify}/SKILL.md: the four skills with their generated reference tables
- docs/grammar.md: the deck grammar (slide kinds, layouts, blocks, rules)

## Rules

- Every mutating action requires baseRevision and rejects a stale one with 409 and the current document.
- Every write returns the normalized result; re-read from the response, not from memory.
- Unknown fields are rejected with unknown_field and a JSON pointer, except under ext on a slide, a block or an asset.
- An agent write to a slide another author leased is refused with 409 and the holder unless force is set.
- A claim about a deck names the revision; render both themes and lint before claiming a slide is done.

## Calling an action over HTTP

- POST /api/actions/<id>; GET /api/actions/<id> returns the action contract: input and output JSON Schema, transports, milestone and whether this instance implements it.
- Body: One JSON object, the action input exactly as the input schema states it; unknown fields are refused with 400 and code unknown_field plus a JSON pointer.
- Deck: ?deck=<slug> names the deck; without it the instance default (gt-brand) is used.
- Author: x-turboslide-author: agent:<runId> (or ?author=); a request without one writes as agent:http.
- Force: ?force=1 (or x-turboslide-force: 1) writes to a slide another author leased; without it the write is 409 with the holder and the current document.
- Auth: Authorization: Bearer <TURBOSLIDE_TOKEN> on every deployed instance; open only on localhost when the instance has no token; a request off localhost without a token is 401.
- Limits: 1048576 bytes per write body, 26214400 bytes per asset upload.
- Errors: { error: { name, status, message, code?, pointer?, currentRevision?, current?, holder?, milestone? } }; TypeError 400, RangeError 404, ConflictError 409, NotImplementedError 501, Error 500.

## MCP over HTTP

- MCP streamable HTTP: POST JSON-RPC to /mcp (initialize first), GET for the notification stream, DELETE to end the session; the mcp-session-id header carries the session.
- One MCP session is bound to one deck and one author at initialize; tools are deck_<action> for every implemented action on the mcp transport.
- ?deck=<slug> on the initialize request; the instance default otherwise. x-turboslide-author or ?author= on the initialize request; agent:mcp-http otherwise.
- deck_goto_slide (view.goto) is listed when a studio page (/edit or /deck) is attached to the deck and runs in that page.

## Leases and revisions

- slide.lease takes ten minutes on a slide; an agent write to a slide another author holds is 409 with the holder unless force is set; a human write warns and goes through (SPEC 6.7).
- Every mutating action takes baseRevision; a stale one is 409 with currentRevision and the current document; re-read from the response and retry once.

## Renders and exports over HTTP

- GET /api/render/<slideId>?deck=<deckId>&theme=light|dark&scale=1|2 answers the PNG with the RenderRecord in the X-Turboslide-Record header; ?format=json (or Accept: application/json) answers the record. ?w=160|320|640 is the cached thumbnail.
- POST /api/export/<deckId> takes the export.run input as one JSON object (format defaults to pptx; out is ignored, the file lands in the job folder). ?sync=1 (or "sync": true in the body) runs the export inside the request and answers the file, or the ExportReport with the files and their URLs under ?format=json (or Accept: application/json); the X-Turboslide-Export-Report header carries the summary.
- A hosted studio (a serverless function) runs every POST synchronously, ?sync=1 or not, and says so in X-Turboslide-Sync: hosted: a queued job would get CPU only while another request kept the instance busy, and its record lives on that instance alone. Send ?sync=1 so the request means the same everywhere.
- In a checkout or against the Docker worker, a POST without ?sync=1 answers 202 with the job and a Location to poll: GET /api/export/<deckId>?job=<id> for the record (the ExportReport under report once done), GET without job for the deck's jobs.
- A file over 4.5 MB cannot leave a function: the route answers 302 to the stored copy when the deployment has a Blob store, else 413 with the JSON body; export one theme or a slide subset then.
- Auth: both routes require Authorization: Bearer <TURBOSLIDE_TOKEN> when the instance has the token set (the thumbnail variant of the render route stays open for the editor); without it they are open.

## Transports

- cli: turboslide <command> --json --author agent:<runId>
- mcp: turboslide mcp (stdio) or POST /mcp (streamable HTTP); tools deck_<action>
- http: POST /api/actions/<id> with the input as JSON
- window: window.turboslide.studio.invoke(<id>, input) after the turboslide:studio-api-ready event

## Skills

- turboslide-create (skills/turboslide-create/SKILL.md): Write or revise slides in the grammar
- turboslide-api (skills/turboslide-api/SKILL.md): Discover and write through the action table
- turboslide-studio (skills/turboslide-studio/SKILL.md): Drive the studio through the window API
- turboslide-verify (skills/turboslide-verify/SKILL.md): Render, lint, judge and verify exports

## Verification

- Render both themes, read the contact sheet by its cell map, run the grammar linter, judge with the six lenses (deck_review prompt), verify exports against the web render (skills/turboslide-verify).
- A claim about a deck names the revision it was verified at; a severity 3 finding blocks the ship step.

## Actions

Every mutating action takes baseRevision. The transports column says where the action is offered; an action whose milestone has not landed answers NotImplementedError (501).

- deck.info (Deck info; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M1): Title, theme, sections with slide ids and titles, counts and the current revision. Input: none. CLI: turboslide info. MCP: deck_get_info.
- deck.create (New deck; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M4): Creates a deck under decks/ from the GT brand template or as one title slide, and returns its id, revision and counts. Input: name, from, id?. CLI: turboslide deck create <name> --from <from> --id <id>. MCP: deck_create.
- deck.rename (Rename deck; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M4): Sets the deck title, the name the sidebar head, the toolbar and the deck list show; one deck.set of /title. Input: name, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide deck rename <name>. MCP: deck_rename.
- deck.pack (Pack deck bundle; read; cli; M6): Writes decks/<id> (deck.json, slides, assets, versions and the sidecars) as one zip with a manifest.json carrying the bundle version, the deck id, its revision and a digest per file (docs/deck-transfer.md). Input: id, out?, versions?. CLI: turboslide deck pack <id> --out <out>.
- deck.unpack (Unpack deck bundle; mutates; cli; M6): Creates a deck under decks/ from a bundle zip after validating it, under a free id when the bundle id is taken unless `replace` removes the deck that holds it (docs/deck-transfer.md). Input: file, as?, replace?. CLI: turboslide deck unpack <file> --as <as> --replace.
- deck.push (Push deck to a studio; mutates; cli; M6): Packs decks/<id> and uploads the bundle to a hosted studio through POST /api/decks/bundle with the bearer token, so the deck can be edited there (docs/deck-transfer.md). Input: id, to, token?, as?, replace?, fromUrl?. CLI: turboslide deck push <id> --to <to> --token <token> --as <as> --replace --from-url <fromUrl>.
- deck.pull (Pull deck from a studio; mutates; cli; M6): Downloads a deck bundle from a hosted studio through GET /api/decks/<id>/bundle with the bearer token and unpacks it into decks/, so the deck can be edited locally (docs/deck-transfer.md). Input: id, from, token?, as?, replace?. CLI: turboslide deck pull <id> --from <from> --token <token> --as <as> --replace.
- slide.list (List slides; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M1): Every slide in deck order with its number, section, title, kind and lint counts. Input: sectionId?. CLI: turboslide slides. MCP: deck_list_slides.
- slide.get (Get slide; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M1): The normalized slide, the assets it references and its last render record. Input: slideId. CLI: turboslide slide get <slideId>. MCP: deck_get_slide.
- slide.insert (Insert slide; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Inserts a slide into a section after the named slide, or first. Input: sectionId, after?, slide, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide slide insert --section <sectionId> --after <after> < slide.json. MCP: deck_insert_slide.
- slide.remove (Remove slide; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Removes a slide from the deck and its section. Input: slideId, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide slide remove <slideId>. MCP: deck_remove_slide.
- slide.move (Move slide; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Moves a slide to a section after the named slide, or first. Input: slideId, sectionId, after?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide slide move <slideId> --to <sectionId> --after <after>. MCP: deck_move_slide.
- slide.update (Patch slide; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Applies a mutation list to one slide and returns the normalized slide with its findings. Input: slideId, baseRevision, mutations. CLI: turboslide slide patch <slideId> --set <pointer>=<value>. MCP: deck_update_slide.
- slide.replace (Replace slide; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Replaces a slide with the given document; what the source drawer’s Apply emits. Input: slideId, baseRevision, slide. CLI: turboslide slide put <slideId> < slide.json. MCP: deck_replace_slide.
- slide.setLayout (Set layout; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M6): Moves a content slide to another layout and refiles its blocks: to freeform every block gets a position box from its slot, from freeform the boxes are dropped and the blocks fall into the target slots by geometry (docs/freeform.md). Input: slideId, layout, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide slide set-layout <slideId> --type <type> --ratio <ratio> --gap <gap> --layout <layout>. MCP: deck_set_layout.
- block.set (Set block property; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Writes one property of a block by JSON pointer; an absent value deletes it. Input: slideId, blockId, path, value?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide block set <slideId>#<blockId> <path> <value>. MCP: deck_update_block.
- block.insert (Insert block; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Inserts a block into a slot after the named block, or first. Input: slideId, slot, after?, block, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide block insert <slideId> --slot <slot> --after <after> < block.json. MCP: deck_insert_block.
- block.remove (Remove block; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Removes a block from its slide. Input: slideId, blockId, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide block remove <slideId>#<blockId>. MCP: deck_remove_block.
- block.move (Move block; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Moves a block to a slot after the named block, or first. Input: slideId, blockId, slot, after?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide block move <slideId>#<blockId> --slot <slot> --after <after>. MCP: deck_move_block.
- block.align (Align blocks; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M6): Aligns the position boxes of freeform blocks on one edge, against the selection, the content box or the sheet, and snaps the result unless snap is false. Input: slideId, blockIds, edge, to?, snap?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide block align <slideId> --blocks <blockIds> --edge <edge> --to <to>. MCP: deck_align_blocks.
- block.distribute (Distribute blocks; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M6): Spreads freeform blocks along one axis with equal gaps between the first and the last, or with a fixed gap; with snap the moved edges round to the 8 px grid. Input: slideId, blockIds, axis, gap?, snap?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide block distribute <slideId> --blocks <blockIds> --axis <axis> --gap <gap>. MCP: deck_distribute_blocks.
- block.order (Order block; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M6): Moves a freeform block through the stacking order, to the front or back or by one step, or to a given z rank, and renumbers the stack densely. Input: slideId, blockId, move?, z?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide block order <slideId>#<blockId> --move <move> --z <z>. MCP: deck_order_block.
- section.set (Set sections; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Replaces the section list, the only place slide order lives. Input: sections, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide sections set < sections.json. MCP: deck_set_sections.
- slide.lease (Lease slide; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Takes a lease on a slide for the author; another author’s write is rejected with 409 unless forced. Input: slideId, minutes?, force?, release?. CLI: turboslide lease <slideId> --minutes <minutes> --force --release. MCP: deck_lease_slide.
- asset.add (Add asset; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M5): Adds a file, a data URL or a fetched URL as an asset with its role, alt, license fields and optional two-tone treatment; returns the asset with twins and metrics. Input: id?, file?, url?, role, alt, source?, title?, artist?, license?, shareAlike?, sourceUrl?, credit?, twoTone?, treatment?, plate?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide asset add <file> --role <role> --alt <alt> --two-tone --black <black> --plate <plate>. MCP: deck_asset_add.
- asset.dither (Dither asset; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M5): Re-runs the two-tone pipeline on an asset with new parameters and reports plate clearance; with fromRecorded it reads the committed twins back and verifies them cell for cell. Input: assetId?, treatment?, params?, plate?, source?, allTwoTone?, fromRecorded?, verifyCells?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide asset dither <assetId> --gamma <gamma> --plate <plate> --all-two-tone --from-recorded --verify-cells. MCP: deck_asset_dither.
- asset.capture (Capture page; mutates; cli, mcp, http; M5): Captures a page at 1440 by 900 in one or both themes through a per-site recipe, optionally cropped to a region, with identical-region 2x detail crops as further assets. Input: url, id?, alt?, role?, viewport?, scale?, theme, region?, details?, recipe?, settleMs?, format?, allowHosts?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide asset capture <url> --theme <theme> --scale <scale> --recipe <recipe> --region <region>. MCP: deck_asset_capture.
- material.capture (Capture material; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M5): Renders a shader material at 3200 by 1800 and captures frozen frames at the given anchors as assets with recipe keys, through the two-tone screen when asked; one anchor returns the asset, several the list. Input: materialId, preset?, uniforms?, size?, anchors, id?, role?, alt?, twoTone?, treatment?, plate?, backend?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide material capture <materialId> --preset <preset> --uniforms <uniforms> --anchor <anchors> --two-tone --plate <plate>. MCP: deck_material_capture.
- material.list (List materials; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M5): The material catalog: every paper:* entry with its uniform schema and palette presets, and the proto:* engines with their availability. Input: materialId?. CLI: turboslide material list. MCP: deck_material_list.
- render.slide (Render; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M1): Renders slides in one or both themes at 1x or 2x and returns render records with image paths. Input: slideIds, themes?, scale?, format?, out?. CLI: turboslide render <slideIds> --theme <themes> --out <out> --json. MCP: deck_render.
- render.sheet (Contact sheet; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M1): Renders a contact sheet per theme with a JSON cell map from cell boxes to slide ids. Input: slideIds, themes?, cols?, thumb?, numbered?, overlay?, out?. CLI: turboslide sheet <slideIds> --cols <cols> --thumb <thumb> --overlay <overlay>. MCP: deck_sheet.
- lint.run (Lint; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M1): Runs the grammar linter on slides in the static, rendered or both layers and returns findings. Input: slideIds, layers?, rule?. CLI: turboslide lint <slideIds> --json. MCP: deck_lint.
- fix.run (Fix; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Applies the fix mutations of findings that carry one and reports what remains. Input: slideIds, rule?, dryRun?, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide fix <slideIds> --rule <rule> --dry-run. MCP: deck_fix.
- diff.run (Diff; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): The mutation list between two revisions in prose, optionally with before and after crops. Input: from?, to?, staged?, render?, themes?, out?. CLI: turboslide diff <from> <to> --staged --render --theme <themes> --out <out>. MCP: deck_diff.
- version.save (Save version; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Saves a named version at the current revision. Input: note. CLI: turboslide version save -m <note>. MCP: deck_version_save.
- version.list (List versions; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): The saved versions with author, note and revision. Input: none. CLI: turboslide version list. MCP: deck_version_list.
- version.restore (Restore version; mutates; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Restores a version as a mutation, so it is undoable and visible in History. Input: n, baseRevision. CLI: turboslide version restore <n>. MCP: deck_version_restore.
- judge.bundle (Judge bundle; read; cli, mcp; M4): Packages renders, sheets with cell maps, render records and findings into a directory for a judge run. Input: slideIds, out. CLI: turboslide judge bundle --out <out>. MCP: deck_judge_bundle.
- view.goto (Go to slide; read; window, mcp; M3): Shows a slide in the viewer, the editor or the presenter. Input: slideId. MCP: deck_goto_slide.
- view.mode (View mode; read; window; M3): Switches between slide, grid and book mode. Input: mode. MCP: deck_set_view.
- view.theme (View theme; read; window; M3): Sets the theme of chrome and sheet together through the gt-theme key. Input: theme. MCP: deck_set_view.
- view.present (Present; read; window; M3): Enters or leaves present mode. Input: on. MCP: deck_set_view.
- export.run (Export; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M2): Exports the deck to PPTX in flatten (perfect, pixel identical) or native (editable text) mode and returns the verified report. Input: format, mode?, theme?, fonts?, embedFonts?, headings?, rasterScale?, pictureScale?, excludeShareAlike?, baseline?, verify?, slideIds?, out?. CLI: turboslide export <format> --mode <mode> --theme <theme> --fonts <fonts> --embed-fonts --exclude-share-alike --baseline-target <baseline> --verify --out <out>. MCP: deck_export.
- export.check (Check export file; read; cli; M6): Reopens an exported PPTX with python-pptx, walks the package against its content types and relationships, and reports the pages, size, raster formats, fonts and any invalid part. Input: file, python?, quickLook?, out?. CLI: turboslide export check <file> --python <python> --out <out>.
- build.run (Build standalone; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M1): Writes the single-file HTML deck with fonts and assets inlined and asserts the size budget. Input: out, budgetMB?, quality?. CLI: turboslide build --out <out> --budget <budgetMB>. MCP: deck_build.
- fonts.build (Build export fonts; read; cli; M2): Cuts the static export font set from InterVariable into packages/fonts/export with fonts.json (scripts/build-fonts.py); --check reports a stale committed set. Input: check?, python?. CLI: turboslide fonts build --check.
- import.run (Import deck; mutates; cli; M1): Imports the Prototemplate deck HTML into a Turboslide deck and writes the import report. Input: from, into. CLI: turboslide import <from> --into <into>.
- validate.run (Validate; read; cli, mcp, http, window; M1): Validates a deck directory and returns the issues and the normalized document. Input: path?. CLI: turboslide validate <path>. MCP: deck_validate.
- source.read (Read source; read; window; M3): Glyphfield standard action: the exact current source document of the active owner. Input: none.
- source.apply (Apply source; mutates; window; M3): Glyphfield standard action: applies a JSON string or object through the active owner’s validator. Input: value.
- controls.list (List controls; read; window; M3): Glyphfield standard action: the visible interactive controls with labels, data-control ids and values. Input: none.
- control.activate (Activate control; read; window; M3): Glyphfield standard action: activates a control by accessible label or data-control id. Input: string.
- control.set (Set control; read; window; M3): Glyphfield standard action: sets a form control by accessible label or data-control id. Input: label, value.
- artifact.download (Download artifact; read; window; M3): Glyphfield standard action: saves a returned artifact with its deterministic file name. Input: fileName.

## Lint rules

Severity 3 must fix (the gate), 2 should fix, 1 polish; `fix` marks the rules whose findings carry mechanical fix mutations that `turboslide fix` applies.

- sheet/overflow (rendered, severity 3): any data-block box outside 0..1600 by 0..900
- sheet/rail-touch (rendered, severity 2): a text box within 8 px of a rail or rule
- sheet/thumb-legible (rendered, severity 1): text whose rendered size (font size times the diagram scale) is under 2 px at the grid’s 0.14x
- type/floor-15 (rendered, severity 3): computed font size under 15 px on any text node
- type/svg-label-min (both, severity 3): diagram text under 18 px, or 18 px without sm
- type/weight-cap (both, severity 3, fix): display weight above 500 outside spec
- type/face (rendered, severity 3): a font status of fallback for Inter
- type/sizes-ladder (static, severity 2, fix): a heading or paragraph size outside the ladder
- type/ladder (static, severity 2, fix): a typography size on a heading, paragraph, text or box block outside the type ladder
- color/tokens-only (static, severity 3): a color literal in html CSS or raw svg outside the sanctioned exceptions (swatch, panel, logoPlates)
- color/semantic-icons-only (static, severity 3): a semantic hue on anything but an Icon
- color/off-palette (static, severity 2): a custom hex color on a primitive block instead of a palette token, named with the block
- icon/placement (static, severity 3): an icon outside a rows key, a plain row start, a board state or a dia; size not 20 or 24
- icon/known (static, severity 3): an IconName not in the sprite
- rows/two-lines (rendered, severity 2): a row value taller than two line heights
- rows/key-snap (static, severity 1, fix): a key width outside the snap set
- dia/label-clearance (both, severity 2): a label box within 12 px of a stroke
- dia/stroke-grammar (static, severity 2): stroke not 1 or 1.5, round caps or joins, filled arrowheads over 8 px, fill outside ink, paper, plate
- dia/fit-slot (static, severity 1, fix): a viewBox width that does not equal its slot width
- dia/half-pixel (static, severity 1, fix): an odd-width stroke on an integer coordinate
- asset/twin-or-border (static, severity 3, fix): a shot or pair image with a neutral twin and no border
- asset/credit-on-plate (static, severity 3): a share-alike source whose credit is missing from the plate
- asset/license-missing (static, severity 2): a photograph with no license record
- asset/stretched (rendered, severity 2): an image drawn at an aspect other than its file’s, outside crop
- picture/plate-clear (static, severity 2): lit cells inside the plate rectangle or within 30 px of it
- picture/blank-twin (static, severity 3): a two-tone twin with lit fraction under 0.02 or over 0.98
- picture/mood-placement (static, severity 2): a mood slide directly before an opener, or two mood slides adjacent
- opener/sentence-lists-section (static, severity 1): the opener sentence does not mention each family in the section
- lines/law (rendered, severity 2): doubled hairlines within 4 px, junctions drawn twice, a border color outside the three roles
- copy/heading-period (static, severity 3, fix): a heading, plate title or key ending in a period
- copy/sentence-case (static, severity 2, fix): a heading with Title Case outside the proper-noun and token lists
- copy/token-first (static, severity 2): a heading starting with a product token
- copy/heading-is-name (static, severity 2): a heading containing a domain
- copy/no-em-dash (static, severity 3, fix): an em dash present
- copy/no-exclamation (static, severity 3, fix): an exclamation mark present
- copy/no-eyebrow (static, severity 2): a short cap or all-caps line as the first block above a heading
- copy/full-sentence-caption (static, severity 1, fix): a caption without a terminal period
- copy/contrast-pair (static, severity 1): "not" followed by a comma clause, for the copy judge
- copy/metaphor-candidate (static, severity 1): a word list hit (journey, unlock, supercharge)
- contrast/both-themes (rendered, severity 2): sampled text against ground under 4.5:1 (3:1 at 26 px and up) in either theme
- layout/empty-half (rendered, severity 2): ink coverage under 2 percent in one column of a cols slide while the other exceeds 10
- layout/pair-gaps (rendered, severity 2): unequal gaps in a pair or details grid beyond 2 px
- layout/columns-aligned (rendered, severity 2): tops of side-by-side rows blocks differing by more than 1 px
- layout/freeform (static, severity 1): a slide on the freeform layout, whose blocks are positioned by hand instead of by the grammar
- freeform/overlap (static, severity 1): two text-carrying blocks of a freeform slide whose boxes overlap
- freeform/off-sheet (static, severity 3): a positioned block whose box leaves the 1600 by 900 sheet
- scales/marker-equals-value (static, severity 3): a marker authored rather than derived; only possible in imported html
- escape/html-block (static, severity 2): an html block exists; export is raster for it
- export/non-native (static, severity 1): a block that exports as raster in the requested mode, listed per export
- numbers/contradiction (static, severity 1): the same noun with different numerals across slides, for the accuracy judge
- count/hard-coded (static, severity 3): a numeral equal to the slide count inside copy that should derive from the deck
